guidance.summary: Consumer Durable division full year growth range
guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: On the outlook, we believe industry will be flattish this year, while we continue to remain optimistic that this division should grow in the range of 13% to 15% for the full year basis.

guidance.summary: Electronics division full year EBITDA margins
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, driven by strong growth momentum and portfolio of high-value margin-accretive products, we expect FY '27 full year EBITDA margins to be in double-digit number.
Backed by a strong order book visibility of INR2,600 crores plus and product portfolio expansion, we remain optimistic of doubling the division's revenue over next 2 financial years.

guidance.summary: Doubling railway division's revenue over next 2 financial years
guidance.quote: With a robust order book and expanding product portfolio, we remain confident in doubling the divisional revenue over the next 2 financial years.

guidance.speaker: Jasbir Singh
guidance.quote: I believe we should see somewhere about 40% growth kind of a story in Sidwal next year itself.
